reviews.title: HK Express has no heart
reviews.text: I booked a flight then my company required me to change the dates. I had to change one week later. The tickets originally cost me HKD5000. HK Express charged me HK$2400 to make the change. The only other choice I had was to lose the HKD5000. I understand being charged a fee for the charge but a HKD2400 fee. That is extortion in my book. I will never EVER fly this airline again!
reviews.author: Terry L

reviews.title: You thought Frontier or Spirit were BAD!
reviews.text: Worse than Frontier or Spirit. COULD NOT Check in online therefore could not also check in for next flight on Cathay Pacific. Get to airport and seat assigned are different than my wife. CAN"T CHANGE SEATS SAYS AGENT..SYSTEM WON'T LET ME. Next segment seats were middle seats. STAY AWAY...flight was half full so this airline hopefully will NOT be around for long.
reviews.author: Peter S

reviews.title: Terrible service, staff and experience.
reviews.text: Hello. I am just for warning anyone. Do not be deceived by want seems like a convenient , efficient service. I had to book three flights. On the same route. On three consecutive days. All expenses on my back. As the airline refused to assist me, be accountable for their faulty booking service. And I barely scraped in the third flight I managed to get on just using the self service check in. Anyone in your HR department reading this, feel free to return my emails at hellomrdanny@protonmail.com I was also charged 4 times for three flights . I could go on. Enough said though I think.
reviews.author: mr danny

reviews.title: At lease better than Hong Kong Airlines
reviews.text: Was a good travel experience for a budget airline of Cathay Pacific, Everything was expected and I hope that HK express can improve in their food and entertainment systems.
reviews.author: Alyas Yeung

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Inflexible and not helpful to assist with change of seat where a fee was already charged. Be prepared for pay for extra on top of what you have already paid. Won't recommend.
reviews.author: HG

reviews.title: The WORST airline ever
reviews.text: Extremely long wait times at check-in and tiny weight allowances (only 7kg for carry-on and 20kg for checked bags). I ended up spending more money than saving when I went over the limit and had to pay ~ $15 usd per kilogram. So then I purchased another 20kg weight allowance for the return flight for around $100 usd by through phone call only to have the check-in counter not get notified. Ended up waiting almost an hour in total whilst they get things confirmed. To add the cherry on top, the Hong Kong check-in staff was extremely rude and impatient. I will never fly this airline again and I urge everyone else not to. You WILL NOT be saving any money. PS - they don’t let you bring outside food or drinks on the plane and sell you a tiny bottle of water at an inflated price.
reviews.author: Mimi X.

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: Wonderful staff, wonderful flight and experience can't be beat. I was treated as good as I would have been with Major airlines and couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: jgkenned

reviews.title: Denied boarding for unjustified COVID reasons
reviews.text: My wife and I took flight UO 646 from Hong Kong to Tokyo on April 24th, 2023, with a scheduled departure time of 13:00. When we checked in at 11:45, we presented negative PCR test reports from a local China hospital (People's Hospital in Dapeng New District, Shenzhen, China.) However, the airline staff informed us that these reports did not meet Japan's entry requirements and refused to allow us to board the flight. They instructed us to obtain new PCR tests from another counter at Hong Kong International Airport. As a result, we had to get new tests and purchase two new tickets for a flight departing at 17:35. We paid an additional HKD 4414 in total for the new tickets and the cost of the tests, as well as losing the amount we had previously paid for the original tickets, including baggage and in-flight food services. We also had to wait for an additional 4.5 hours at Hong Kong airport. When we landed in Tokyo, we presented the exact same PCR test reports from the local China Hospital and were allowed to enter Japan without any issues. This suggests that the airline's reason for denying us boarding was unjustified. The PCR tests from the hospital comply with China's infectious disease prevention and control regulations, and the testing procedures and results have been scientifically validated through extensive clinical trials. Furthermore, I suspect that the HongKong Express airline company and the Hong Kong-based PCR testing provider, Prenetics, may be engaged in irregular or fraudulent procedures to obtain unfair profits by harming passengers' property and rights
reviews.author: PanWei

reviews.title: Chaotic ride to Hong Kong
reviews.text: The flight to Hong Kong is far from pleasant and comfortable. It seems as if massive migration is going on and every passenger scrambles for space at overhead compartment. Staff looks clueless on the situation. Upon arrival in Hong Kong, there was a long queue for ground transportation. Waiting for checked luggage is another issue. It took two hours to get out of the airport. Well, this is a budget airline.
reviews.author: Leonhkny

reviews.title: Budget airline
reviews.text: This is so far the cheapest transport option between Hong Kong and Osaka. Given the price, I had no expectation on the trip. As expected, it is a full flight with a large crowd of children. Overhead carriage was cramped and the seat is far from comfortable. Well, you pay what you get.
reviews.author: Leonhkny

reviews.title: Useless website and App. Be very careful when you book with their app.
reviews.text: I tried to book through their website multiples times and never worked...After you enter all the details, it always pops up with the error message that ask you to book via their App. I downloaded the app and it is also very unstable. I booked my ticket finally however the auto-correction of the app changed the passenger name in the last minute!!!! I didn't roll all the way up to check it because I did manually input the correct name. Then of coz the ticket was booked with a wrong name. I immediately contacted the customer service via an online form and WhatsApp. Didn't get someone to reply in two days. One message in WhatsApp was "may I contact you in Chinese". I was very frustrated if the customer service only available in Chinese, why don't they list it clearly on the website. The third day I finally received an email stating that i cannot change the passenger name and it's non refundable. They charge you HK$350 dollars and you can change 3 letters only. so basically I have to buy another ticket due to their poorly designed app. One more thing the flight information won't show up again before you make the payment. It means before you press the pay button, you have no chance to review all the details at all. What I felt was the total set up seems like a trap so customers easily make mistakes while they book their ticket. I sincerely hope the company could fix their website because the screen is just simply bigger and there are still a lot of people use their PC to do things. If they only want people to book using the app, then please also review the user interface as well. In summary, it is just a very frustrating process and it is much easier to just book ticket using other websites or fly with other companies.
reviews.author: mingwai23

reviews.title: Useless online check-in system and counter check-in
reviews.text: Online check-in doesn't allow foreigner to check-in. Only certain country only. When check-in in the counter, the staff told me,"oh, because you didn't online check-in. You guys have to sit seperately. ". In some senses, they are forcing you indirectly to purchase seat if wanna sit together.
reviews.author: Ken Kew

reviews.title: Better buy travel insurance before you fly with HK Express
reviews.text: Picked up a luggage with a labeled sticker “fragile” on both sides and found a crack at top right corner. Then filed a claim for damage and complaint. Received a report from HK Express to claim my travel insurance. They are not accountable for these claims. In order words, if their planes crash and you are lucky to submit a claim to your travel insurance. Because HK Express is not responsible for any damages or losses caused by its operation. Therefore we, as passengers, highly recommend to purchase travelers insurance before you fly HK Express.
reviews.author: Barry C

reviews.title: Expensive and poor customer service
reviews.text: The 2 hour flight was more expensive than most 5 hour flights I get with Scoot or Airasia. Only chose them cause they were the only direct flight from Seoul to Hong Kong. Decided I need check in luggage so went to their website to purchase while check in. Could not check in online in 2023 and of course, no baggage purchase. Tried their live chat and it doesnt load. Tried their phone number in korea and no one answers. Tried their Whatsapp, takes someone to reply after 30+minutes only to tell me to provide details and someone will contact me later. I'm just trying to check in and pay for baggage??? Ridiculous
reviews.author: James000009

reviews.title: Incompetent or corrupt you decide
reviews.text: My experience is as bad as others have reported. At the check-in gate, the staff insisted on documents which do not exist. As a frequent traveler between the two cities, I explained the Hong Kong immigration procedure. A supervisor was called in who was equally clueless. Eventually I lost patience and raised my voice so other passengers could hear what was going on. Very quickly the fake document requirements disappeared and I was handed my boarding pass. I suspect they were trying to solicit a bribe but it could be sheer incompetence.
reviews.author: pkuerten

reviews.title: Not too bad!
reviews.text: HK Express is Hong Kong's budget airline and has a mixed reception. Our recent flight to Tokyo is a straightforward fare. Everything from check-in to on-boarding is smooth and largely hazzle-free. Yes, seats are cramped and meal and entertainment are non-available, but price is unbeatable. Basically it is a fair deal. Crew is quite polite.
reviews.author: Leonhkny

reviews.title: Don't even try this airline
reviews.text: Was there 1 hr before the boarding time, checked in online, no e boarding pass provided, so have to print at the counter. Guess what, the counter was closed and nobody there, no kiosk, even no any signboard of HK Express. Unable to contact the customer as well, trying to look for airport customer service, but still can't help.
reviews.author: Jyin

reviews.title: Absolutely terrible airline!
reviews.text: Anyone thinking of booking through this airline then please just don't. I booked a flight to Phuket from Hong Kong and they cancelled my flight and put me on another flight on a different day that wasn't suitable for me and my family, therefore I had to cancel the trip. never got a response apart from automated responses and therefore never got a refund! I had to swallow loosing a large amount of money! please, save yourselves a lot of aggravation and book someone else.
reviews.author: Stephen F

reviews.title: Terrible airline with terrible customer service.
reviews.text: Makes you pay for a service and when they fail to deliver said service they refuse a refund. Customer service took 2 weeks to get back to me and then cut me off of the conversation after 3 minutes of not replying. A joke of an airline.
reviews.author: Marcel S

reviews.title: WORST airline EVER!!!
reviews.text: Over 50yrs of flying and this is the WORST airline EVER!!! Won't answer any customer service messages. Cannot change flights without horrendous fees that cost more than just booking a new flight! Terribly rude and unsupportive staff, from the check-in clerk to the main duty manager, were ALL terrible. Damaged some of our luggage and have not heard back from anyone in weeks. AVOID at all costs!!!!!
reviews.author: Robert W

reviews.title: Should be reported to Consumer Council Org in HK
reviews.text: Have an upcoming flight and need help. There is absolutely no customer service available. Have been trying for a week. Phone number doesn't work No response on WhatsApp Contact page on app is blank No response to multiple emails I don't know how this is acceptable as a business. They should be reported to Consumer Council for bad business practices.
reviews.author: PeterHan

reviews.title: Truly horrendous airline
reviews.text: I just have no words for how bad this airline is. I am a seasoned traveler for the last 30 years and have travelled on many a low-cost airline. This is without question the worst. From the outset there were issues, starting with no actual airline ground staff, they outsource to local operators or other airlines. The upshot being when there is an issue which in our case there was, no one is available to support you, there was no number to call on the weekend, no one responds on either FB messenger or WhatsApp. We couldn’t take the flight, we were stranded with a 7-year old child, who was very upset by the stressful situation. In the end with still no contact at all from the airline, we had to book a far more expensive set of tickets with Cathay Pacific. Please take my advice and never, ever fly HK Express, it truly is the worst airline of all time.
reviews.author: William Hurtado

reviews.title: Not recommended - poor and rigid customer service
reviews.text: After this trip, I would NEVER fly with HK express again. I arrived the airport just on time, not more than one minute late, there was still a passenger checking in. The floor staff refused to check me in and said the check in was closed. He’d rather spend 10 mins to argue with me (the previous customer was still checking in) than being helpful. Not helpful for the customer to book the next flight, terrible English (cannot comprehend the difference between rebook or buying a new one).

reviews.title: AWEFUL AND WORSE SERVICE ATTITUE
reviews.text: The HK Express is one of the most rude air line company with hotlines and emails that never answer. Yes they say they have even whatsapp to answer your calls but with bad english the operator who answer always say "sorry I don't understand" "sorry what did you say?" I guess the English level is primary school or less. This company really represent HK as now one of the worse city in Asia! Check in staff is rude and have a mentality that Aryan race is superior and must give special service while other race is not important to them typical bootlicking. Wake up HK is now under PRC rule! PRC should kick Cathy Pacific out of HK for good

reviews.title: Avoid this airline.

I was asking to sit in other seat as aircraft was half full, they told me still I have to sit between other people and they don’t care about Covid or other things. Lady who was supervisor was not able to control her anger and her hands was flying in front of my face, she looks like patronising personnel who is on hot seat. reviews.title: Avoid this airline if you don’t want to be treated as slave, the manager is bullying its staff in front of the customer
reviews.text: The lady’s name is 孫慧妍 I believe she’s the manager at check in desk. She’s so rude and unprofessional. She screamed at me and is so over dramatic. She asked me for visa to Singapore but I don’t need a visa. Then she called her supervisor and double checked, it turned out I don’t need a visa. She called me mainlander in Cantonese, she thought I didn’t understand, that’s so offensive. She’s also bullying other staff. How come this woman become manager? Avoid it if you want to be treated as human instead of slaves

reviews.text: Worst company ever experienced. Flight canceled. No refund. After 2 months case still pending . No after sale phone efficiency, no answer to mail - case closed by the company without providing any reason except: too much claims at this time…

reviews.title: HK EXPRESS WORST AIRLINE AWFUL SERVICE- NEVER TAKE IT
reviews.text: This airline is the worst airline I have ever travel in, they don't have enough staff, they took hours to help me and theh didn't solve absolutely nothing. They allow me to take the flight from hong kong to bangkok without informing me that I couldn't transit, because you didn't had an agreement with any airline, reason why I had to buy a ticket back to Hong Kong (they didn't even pay it) and get a new ticket for over 300 euros to go again to the original destination. They as an airline are in the obligation of verify my documents, and I specifically asked if I could do my transit and their officials said YES, I had to sleep two days in the airport and eat as well, for which they didn't gave me any money back. NEVER TAKE HK EXPRESS

reviews.title: Not able to use my US credit card to book it online-Worst Customer Support Center!
reviews.text: Kept rejecting my booking (of 8 ppl)with my US issued credit cards(tried two different cards) when I tried to pay. Customer service does not know why and kept asking me to try over and over again. I finally got an agent to help me with the reservation but she was going to charge me more because it was made through them. Very bad phone system as the background noise prevented me from hearing the agent's conversation. I wanted to use them for the first time but I think I am going to take my money to other airlines.

reviews.title: Their customer service doesn’t reply. Never. Shame on you
reviews.text: Their customer service doesn’t reply. Never. Shame on you. This company shouldn’t have license to fly. They are embarrassment. They don’t reply any message. They don’t exist. Shame on you.

reviews.title: Wow quite possibly the worst airline in the world...
reviews.text: Wow quite possibly the worst possible service in regards to changing a first name ever. Long story short, I accidentally input the international name for one of the passengers on the booking as that information as well as the passport information usually comes during the booking procedure and not after when you have purchased the tickets (one of their shady practices). Noticing my mistake, I went to contact their customer service in regards to a simple name change which they would not do as it violates their 'company policy' which coincidentally violates my rights as a consumer to a simple name change. They also would not refund me my booking as the tickets are non refundable but only the taxes would be partially refunded which would have left me with a less than 10% refund. As this is also unacceptable, I have lodged this complaint to my city's government in the hopes of resolving this issue as a simple first name change shouldnt be that difficult, should it?

reviews.title: Thieves
reviews.text: So this thieving airline changes your flight schedule and then says that it will only allow rebooking, no refunds, and if the new booking fare is higher than you pay the difference. But of course, when it's lower they don't refund the difference... Even though the rebooking is their fault, since they changed the original booking. Bunch of thieves. Last time my family ever flies with them.

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: They were selling an 8:15 am flight and just canceled it last moment and turned it to 13:20. No compensation or apology offered and wasn’t even willing to add a priority tag to luggage in order to help me make my meeting at my destination. Never fly HK Express, an unapologetic scamming airline
reviews.author: Max

reviews.title: Sell flights that don't exist
reviews.text: This company has been selling flights from Hong Kong to Phuket knowing that they will cancel it for a year! Book your flight, pay, receive a cancellation weeks later!! AVOID!!
reviews.author: anthony g

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs!
reviews.text: This airline company cancels flights at random, there are no other options available to change the schedule to, no contact numbers, slow email reply (takes as much as a week to get a reply!), and they give you a refund after 6 to 8 weeks, when the cause of this whole mess lies with them. Wtf? I will NEVER, EVER buy tickets from this airline. AVOID AT ALL COSTS. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED. 최악의 항공사. 멋대로 항공편 취소시키고 잘못은 자기네들한테 있는데 환불은 6~8주나 걸림. 다시는 이용 안할 것임. 최악! 최악! 최악!
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.title: Do not trust - completely unaware and couldn’t care less about official travel policy
reviews.text: Seeing all the bad reviews, I don’t really like to pile on, except I feel it is my duty as a human to stop anyone else going through what we have had to. Don’t trust the airline HK Express. They sold us a ticket to Mainland China allowing us to transfer in Hong Kong, however this fails to recognise that transit in Hong Kong to Mainland China is not allowed. When purchasing the ticket over the phone, we were twice told that it would be fine. When we ourselves realised and informed them of this, they refused again and again to give us a full refund, instead saying they will ‘escalate’ the case - which really does nothing but make you wait for them to call you back and say nothing different apart from some additional lies. They even told us we should have known and we should have checked - as far as I’m concerned it’s the airline’s responsibility to know where and how they can fly. Or, when realising they are wrong - offering a refund should be a no-brainer. Yet, they continue to sell the exact same ticket - fraudulent if you ask me. And also to understand the industry. They have not been able to get their head around the fact that despite two legs of a single ticket ‘operating as normal’, the ticket as a whole cannot be used and is therefore invalid and illegitimate. It amazed me to find out that it is owned by Cathay Pacific, it really should embarrass them to be associated. Get up to speed, HK Express. Not just with entry policies, but this whole travelling during COVID thing.
reviews.author: B Chao

reviews.title: Pathetic customer service
reviews.text: They moved our flight back 3 full days and refused to work with us to modify the flight. I’m assuming their crappy customer support is just reflection of their crappy country.
reviews.author: Zach L

reviews.title: DOUBLE STANDARDS
reviews.text: In reality HK Express would not care of your satisfaction and review on TripAdvisor; perhaps it is a budget airline and apparently, just wants to earn more money. I, however, really want to share what I encountered……This was truly my most horrendous flight experience that I have ever had in my life, thus far. My partner and I took the flight from Siem Reap to Hong Kong tonight (i.e. 17th December 2019). At the time of checking-in at the Siem Reap International Airport, the ground staff claimed that our carry-on luggage (including one additional personal item) was not fit into the dimension of 56 x 36 x 23 cm that was pre-determined by HK Express; however, at the same time, we realized that there were a bunch of passengers and, above all, their situations were even severe or similar with us. Under this circumstance, we did think that we were outrageously stereotyped, and were forced to check-in our luggage by paying a lump sum of USD 50 for checked luggage fee. I attempted to take more photos in their presence, so that I can have stronger evidences when lodging a complaint later on, but I was threatened to be kicked out by the security guard from the Cambodia Airport if I took a photo (AT THE END THE SECURITY GUARD WAS JUST NEXT TO US EVEN THOUGH WE PROVIDED THE CREDIT CARD TO THEM FOR A PAYMENT). Subsequently, I attempted to gather the name of the concerned ground staff. Initially, they agreed to do so, but at the end, they used several ways to dodge about it (IF THERE WAS NO MISTAKE OR PREJUDICE/ STEREOTYPE, HOW COME THE GROUND STAFF AVOIDED PROVIDING THE NAME AND STOPPING ME TO TAKE PHOTOS?). More villainously the ground staff kept giggling at us. When I came back to Hong Kong, I immediately wrote a letter of complaint to its Guest Relations Department, since I heartily wished that my complaint will be seriously followed up, and will draw your management’s attention. Seemingly no one cared. This was truly a big insult and a serious stereotype towards the passengers. I used HK Express several times, at least 3 times. If I wanted to give trouble to HK Express, I should do it on my first trip. For example, - WCGQ6X – I went to Tokyo, Japan with my families. When I needed luggage allowance, I bought 50 kg luggage allowance for a round-trip flight per person. - G57YJP – I went to Fukuoka, Japan with my friends. When I needed luggage allowance, I bought 20 kg luggage allowance for a return flight per person. At that moment, my luggage was over-weighted for 8 kg and the ground staff requested me to pay JPY 3100 for the overweight checked baggage. I did not argue, whereas I paid immediately. - AYQL6K – During this time, I think it was really not necessary, and that is why I did not buy any luggage allowance. I felt strange that both of our luggage were verbally approved by the ground staff in Hong Kong, before we took the flight from Hong Kong to Siem Reap. When we did the same thing in Siem Reap, our baggage was disapproved. And, we really did not know why only our baggage was measured, but other suspected larger baggage were NOT measured. Is it because we were not foreigners or, we did not pay tips? For no doubt this issue really deserves immediate management’s attention and, everyone should deserve a fair and the same treatment with other passengers. Should any like-minded travellers need more information pertaining to this issue, you can reach me by following my TripAdvisor’s page, and I am definitely delighted to share more details with you.
reviews.author: VinsYHL

reviews.title: Will not issue corona refund
reviews.text: Terrible customer service. They cancelled my flight due to corona issues but they refuse to refund my fare.
reviews.author: Danielle W

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Flew from VN to HK, l was pleasant trip, magnificent view, the food was good as well. l will choose flight with HK Express Airline next time, from booking to the end was awesome. Hilghlight recommend it to any travelers.
reviews.author: VMTThomas

reviews.title: Thorough explanation of current situation
reviews.text: the staff was very thorough in explaining the situation regarding the Vietnamese governments' actions towards tourists because of the coronavirus nonetheless it's still sort of the first option for cheap flights for a hongkonger like myself not much extra service was needed since it was a short flight no in-flight entertainment at all did not opt for the 20kg baggage and would recommend for backpacking for this airline, save you a lot trouble from registering at the counter

reviews.title: Plz don’t take U-biz
reviews.text: The lounge don’t offer any hot food until after my 07:05 flight depart. On board is great and the crew are descent.

reviews.title: never take this company
reviews.text: the worst company ever, I booked a flight from Fukuoka to Cairo, using HK express in the first flight, it was terrible, Egyptair company from HK to Cairo allowed 2*23 luggage, I paid for the luggage while I was booking online, but I was shocked, They made me pay for extra weight!!, even 9000 yen higher than the price on their website, fubricated a mistake for my name and made me paid 5000 yen for it!!!, also the plane arrived late, and i was lucky to not miss my next transit flight, the opposite was totally in Egtptair with best service. Also not answer anyphone calls or emails. I just thanked my god once I left HK to Egyptair because of this terrible company.

reviews.title: Another typical low cost experience
reviews.text: You pay for the flight, you pay for your luggage, you pay for extra leg room or emergency seat, you pay for beverage on board. Do you pay to go to the toilet on board? lol! Just another typical low cost company that makes you pay for everything. You don't even get a glass of water for free on a flight that lasts two hours. The staff does their job but you barely get a smile. Only positive thing: we were on time!
reviews.author: LaurentCL2

reviews.title: Worse company unethical.
reviews.text: Happy to take your money I booked a ticket because I was able to Use a sky pier ferry back to shenZhen. The government have now closed this ! It’s impossible then to go to Hong Kong because of the virus and quarantine and the company will not refund !!!! Are you stupid
reviews.author: Steve S

reviews.title: Great way to fly with the LCC - HKExpress
reviews.text: The flight arrived at BKK airport as schedule and thus, the flight to HKG was well on time and punctual departed at 21:00. Flying time was a bit faster than listed, only 2 hour 10 mins (it is 2 hour 50 minutes as listed in the schedule). Announcement from the cockpit was clear and we can hear it clearly rather than some other airlines, the message was not clear enough. Though it is a LCC flight, I don't expect too much and when check in I can get tn asile seat as I request. Good service from ground staffs too. I feel great in flying with LCC of UO.
reviews.author: Frankie

reviews.title: Beware HK Express.
reviews.text: I bought tickets of HK Express from Incheon(Seoul) to Phuket. The departure date was 11 Feb. 2020 and the itinerary was from Incheon(Korea) to Hong Kong (flight UO 619) first and then from Hong Kong to Phucket (flight UO 763). Soon after making an online check-in on 10th Feb. (one day before a departure date), I have received an email from HK Express saying that the departure time of UO619 was delayed about 9 hours. As such a delay makes it impossible for us to take the connecting flight (UO 763) by the same company, I contacted HK Express. They said that they can not guarantee an alternative connecting flight unless our family spend about 24 hours at the HK airport. They also said that they would not compensate my accomodation expenses caused by the delay, even if I would accept their unreasonable offer. As I could not make my two kids spend a full day at the Hong Kong airport, I had to buy new flight tickets from another airlines just one day before a departure date. I was not informed any clear reason of the flight delay. In addition, even if it is inevitable, I can not understand that HK express do not care about their customers.
reviews.author: Myunggon

reviews.title: Great until you need to contact customer service
reviews.text: Impossible to have an answer from their customer service. No one answering calls, e-mails and live chat people read your question and then just never answer. Waste of time. I'll certainly never fly with them again.
reviews.author: Shiruba

reviews.title: Cancelled 2 days before flight home
reviews.text: We flight with HK express from Hong Kong to Phuket for vacation. 2 days before we should fly back we got the information that our flight back is cancelled. There gave us 3 opportunities, one of them was to flight to another location and the other opportunity was to take another date in the next 6 month... thanks for that! 🙄 The we had to take the last opportunity to refund. But the issue is that we had to book short term another flight back to Hong Kong, which was quit the double of what we should get back from HK express for the flight back. As I tried to check this directly on phone I had to wait raffle 2 hours to check for support. I just got a sorry and there didn’t want to have us more back (example part of the first flight from Hong Kong to Phuket). So all in all, due to HK express I lost money and I had a lot of stress on my vacation... Thanks HK Express, never again!
reviews.author: Adam S

reviews.title: Poor operational arrangement
reviews.text: I've booked a flight to a place which doesn't issue any warning on coronavirus (both the origin & destination). So, was supposed to fly on schedule. But I got an email in less than 24 hrs prior to flight departure informing me my flight got cancelled suddenly. They claimed they can offer me refund (which I still haven't got it and not sure how long I need to wait for that). But make me angry is that it totally ruin my trip which i longed for. In addition, cancelling a flight in less than 24 hrs meaning it's hard to get refund for my bookings on the hotel/tour. Also, the e-Visa fee was non-refundable.
